decisions.reason: As a modular trommel screen derived from the established BASIC 518, it is very close to the firm's existing screening know-how and the website signals continuing technical improvement rather than failure.

The mobile flail shredder line fits the firm's core mobile waste-processing competence, and the 2019 rollout of all models with new Stage V engine technology suggests active refinement and commitment.

A mobile high-speed grinder is strongly related to the firm's established shredding and mobile machinery capabilities, and its move from a mention to a dedicated page indicates enough traction to continue learning and commercialization.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line builds directly on the firm's deep shredding and plant-engineering knowledge, and the firm's claim of setting benchmarks plus evidence of use point to a low likelihood of withdrawal.
